outcome: postpartum Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) risk at 6 months
cohort: The study included 341 women in Spain, initially recruited 3 months postpartum, with a mean age of 33.38 years.
finding: A higher perception of obstetric violence is associated with an increased risk of developing postpartum Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder.
mod_finding: Instrumental birth and previous cesarean section were associated with an increased likelihood of developing postpartum Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder.
